description: In every PA model, for a fixed Boolean program \(q(\vec x,i)\), its specified accumulation loop has a Boolean value at every internal length \(j\), and that value is one exactly when \(q(\vec x,i)=1\) for every \(i<j\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BoundedTruthPrograms.allLoop_spec.{u}
  {M : Type u} [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] {r : ℕ}
  (q : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.Program (r + 1)) (x : Fin r → M)
  (hq :
    ∀ (i : M),
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BooleanValue (q.value (Fin.snoc x i)))
  (k : M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BooleanValue
      ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BoundedTruthPrograms.allLoop q).value
        (Fin.snoc x k)) ∧
    ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BoundedTruthPrograms.allLoop q).value
          (Fin.snoc x k) =
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M 1 ↔
      ∀ (i : M),
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M i) k →
          q.value (Fin.snoc x i) = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M 1)
